This dynamic is dangerous because it teaches the narrator to suppress their own needs to accommodate the partner's trauma, which eventually leads to resentment and emotional exhaustion.

The subtext in this scenario is rich with unspoken truths. When She giggled and offered to let the narrator read the texts, the subtext was a power play: *"I know I am doing something that makes you uncomfortable, but I am testing if you will cave.
